description: Check an OpenTimestamps proof (from us or anyone) against the SHA-256 of a file. Returns valid with status complete (Bitcoin block and the time the file existed by), valid with status pending (not in Bitcoin yet), or invalid with a reason. A pending proof whose calendars have since committed it comes back complete with `upgraded: true` and the completed proof in `ots` (base64): save it in place of the pending one. Nothing is stored. Free.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the file, 64 hex characters

name: verify_proof
title: Verify proof
